name: sudo-command-center (teaching edition)
_comment_include: BARE BONES - the system itself, nothing else. Rules, commands, workflows, skills, scripts, templates, and the routing brain. No projects, no session history, no BMAD module (BMAD runs inside a project, not the command center - the skeleton carries it). Tool surface dirs (.claude/.opencode/.antigravity/.agent) are included so commands resolve on first clone rather than only after a /sync-agents.
_comment_exclude: Personal, machine-local, or project-owned. _my_resources is Daniel's personal area; _artifacts is session memory; .gitnexus is a per-machine index; Projects/ holds real client work.
_comment_emptyDirs: Folder exists, nothing inside. TOP-LEVEL ONLY on purpose: the real subfolders here are named after the owner's projects and dated sessions (_artifacts/_main/2026-08-04_..., Projects/<client>), so recreating the tree would leak the names. The newcomer gets the shape and fills it themselves.
_comment_excludeAnywhere: Path segments never copied, wherever they appear.
_comment_substitutions: Most domain references in core commands are incidental examples, not structure. Matching is CASE-SENSITIVE so replacements read naturally in context (DANIEL in a heading becomes THE OPERATOR, not 'the operator'). That means every case variant needs its own row - the case-INSENSITIVE leak scan below is what proves none were missed. Order matters: longest first, so AGY_AVIATIONCHAT is consumed before AVIATIONCHAT.

substitutions._note: Voice-agent names, surviving as INCIDENTAL EXAMPLES in generic files (v3-prompt-architecture uses them as sample entities). Substituted, not excluded. word:true is mandatory - Igor hides inside Rigor, Mac inside Machine.

_comment_transforms: Whole-file swaps for files whose CONTENT is personal, not just its tokens. operator-profile is floor-tier and hard-codes Daniel as chair; unchanged, a stranger's agent believes it is talking to him.

transforms._note: ADDS a file rather than replacing one - the source repo has no .training-mode (its owner is not a learner) but every teaching clone must start with the tutor ON. A transform writes to a path whether or not the source has it.
Also an ADD: the source command center has no README. This one is teaching-edition-specific (it points at /sudo-tour and .training-mode), so it lives here rather than in the owner's repo.

_comment_leakScan: Runs after every export and cannot be skipped. Any hit blocks the push. Matching is case-INSENSITIVE, so it catches case variants the substitution table missed - that is its main job. Every value from the live .env is added automatically. NOTE: _my_resources is deliberately NOT a needle. It is a structural folder name in the workspace standard (a personal area agents never touch) and the teaching edition should keep the concept; only its CONTENTS are excluded.

leakScan._note_sudomadhatter: sudomadhatter is deliberately NOT a needle. The READMEs must carry the real clone URLs (github.com/sudomadhatter/...) or nobody can clone anything - it is the publication address, not a secret. The SUBSTITUTION still rewrites it everywhere else, and transforms run AFTER substitutions, so the hand-authored READMEs keep the real URL while every other file is scrubbed.
leakScan._note_Mac: Mac was tried as a needle and REMOVED: BMAD's own project-types.csv lists 'Mac desktop app', so it false-fired AND the matching substitution corrupted vendor data to 'Chen desktop app'. A lone Mac beside Ada and Bruno identifies nobody.
